arosrainbow.name: ARoS Rainbow Panorama
arosrainbow.slogan: A ring of colour floating over the rooftops of Aarhus.
arosrainbow.line: Olafur Eliasson's glass walkway on the museum roof is 150 metres long and 3 metres wide, and opened in 2011.

dengamleby.name: Den Gamle By
dengamleby.slogan: A whole Danish town, saved house by house.
dengamleby.line: Opened in 1914 as the world's first open-air town museum, it now holds 75 historic buildings from 20 Danish towns.

tollundmanden.name: Tollund Man
tollundmanden.slogan: A 2,400-year-old face that still looks like it is dreaming.
tollundmanden.line: Some day I will go to Aarhus / To see his peat-brown head…
tollundmanden.by: Seamus Heaney, The Tollund Man, Wintering Out, 1972

moesgaard.name: Moesgaard Museum
moesgaard.slogan: Walk up the grass roof, then down to the Iron Age.
moesgaard.line: The Grauballe Man, about 2,300 years old, is among the best preserved bog bodies in the world and lies inside this museum.

himmelbjerget.name: Himmelbjerget
himmelbjerget.slogan: Denmark's 'Sky Mountain' is barely a hill, and the nation loves it.
himmelbjerget.line: The tower on top was unveiled in 1875 to honour King Frederik VII, who gave Denmark its first constitution.
